ClassInsight.//RoomName: Optional. Join only the classroom server with this room name, for networks that host several rooms. Empty = join the first server found.
ClassInsight.//ServerAddress: Optional host or host:port of the server. When set, the agent connects ONLY to this server and skips broadcast discovery (use it where broadcast is blocked, or to pin the lab's server).
ClassInsight.//ReportBrowserActivity: Report the host (domain only, never the full URL) of the foreground browser tab.
ClassInsight.//EnableClassroomControl: Let teachers send messages, lock the screen, open web pages and set web/app/internet/sound limits; shows the raise-hand tray icon.
ClassInsight.//ShowViewingIndicator: Show the student a small on-screen notice while a teacher is viewing their screen (recommended; required in some jurisdictions).
ClassInsight.//AllowPowerCommands: Let teachers log off / restart / shut down this PC. Set false to refuse them locally, whatever the server allows.
ClassInsight.//MaxStreamWidth: Highest stream width (pixels) a teacher may request from this PC: 320-3840. Lower it to save lab bandwidth/CPU.
ClassInsight.//CaptureBackend: DXGI (GPU, default) or GDI. GDI is the automatic fallback anyway; force it only for diagnostics.
